capabilities.scope: Skill discovery and body loading in an interactive session.
capabilities.revalidation_trigger: A release changing how skill metadata or bodies enter context.

probe.gesture: Invoked a named skill in a live session and compared the roster available before invocation with the content available after it.
probe.outcome: Before invocation the roster carried each skill's name and one-line description only. The full body arrived only on invocation.

capabilities.scope: Context a non-fork subagent receives at dispatch.
capabilities.revalidation_trigger: A release changing what a subagent's initial context contains.

probe.gesture: Dispatched a subagent and required it to report facts that existed only in the parent conversation.
probe.outcome: The subagent reported no access to parent conversation content and re-derived every fact from files it opened itself.

capabilities.scope: Whether a subagent may dispatch a subagent, and to what depth.
capabilities.revalidation_trigger: A release changing the default spawn depth or its environment override.

capabilities.scope: Whether parallel sessions can run against isolated checkouts of one repository.
capabilities.revalidation_trigger: A release changing worktree session support or its isolation boundary.

sources.title: Common workflows — run parallel sessions with worktrees

probe.gesture: Ran a full session inside a linked git worktree, inspecting status, rebasing onto the upstream branch, and committing.
probe.outcome: The worktree carried its own HEAD, index and working tree while sharing the parent repository's object store; commits landed on the worktree's own branch only.

capabilities.scope: Whether a hook's declaration site determines the scope it applies to.
capabilities.revalidation_trigger: A release changing the hook configuration scope table.

capabilities.scope: Whether organization-managed policy can define or constrain hooks.
capabilities.revalidation_trigger: A release changing managed-policy precedence over local hook settings.

capabilities.scope: Whether an agent supplied by a package is subordinate to a same-named local agent.
capabilities.revalidation_trigger: A release changing plugin-versus-local agent precedence or namespacing.
